§ 9.9 Synthetic safeguards.

(a) (1) Standard: Access control . Implement controls so that only authorised people reach records.

(2) Implementation specifications: (i) Unique identification (Required). Assign a unique name to each user.

(b) Standard: Audit controls . Implement mechanisms that record and examine activity & usage.

(c) (1) Standard: Integrity . Protect records from improper alteration.
